item.title: CamTran canceling bus services ahead of weekend winter storm
item.description: JOHNSTOWN, Pa. (WTAJ) -- With the impending winter storm predicted to bring snow to the area, causing hazardous conditions, CamTran has announced bus services will be canceled.
